div.div:
BatteryMind — data ingestion and promotion pipeline
Real NASA Ames measurements are verified, transformed deterministically, and promoted only when they reproduce the committed evidence.

div.div:
1 · Download and verify
Fetch the archive (size-bounded) and compare SHA-256 and byte count with data/manifests/nasa-source.json. A mismatch fails the run.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 345px; margin-left: 395px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2 · Preserve the original
Store the unchanged archive at raw/nasa/<sha256>.zip. Original laboratory files are never modified.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 345px; margin-left: 760px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3 · Parse and transform
Read the MATLAB cells and write deterministic Parquet: cycles, samples, impedance, plus a data-quality report. Nothing is filled or simulated.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 345px; margin-left: 1125px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4 · Compare with evidence
Compare each output hash with reports/data_quality/nasa-ingestion.json, which is committed to Git.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 241, 251), rgb(24, 32, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(84, 91, 100), rgb(154, 160, 168));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 322px; height: 1px; padding-top: 345px; margin-left: 1490px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
5 · Promote or refuse
If every hash matches, copy to processed/current/. Otherwise the run is marked FAIL and nothing is promoted. Status is written to processed/runs/<run_id>/status.json.

div.div:
FastAPI service
On startup it loads processed/current/cycles.parquet from S3 (falling back to the copy baked into the image) and serves analytics: capacity, SOH, RUL baseline, decision.

div.div:
Showcase export (scripts/export_showcase.py)
Builds the versioned JSON from the same Parquet. CI regenerates it and requires the derived values to match within 1e-9.

div.div:
Continuous integration
Downloads the real archive, verifies the recorded SHA-256, re-runs ingestion, and fails if the Parquet hashes differ from the committed report. Raw data and Parquet are never committed.
